issues.problem: ko-nani contrast いつ/何時 said 'Only 何時 takes に', which is too broad (何曜日に, 何月に also take に).
issues.action: Reworded: 何時 takes に like any clock time; いつ does not.

issues.problem: ko-nani contrast called 何を思いますか 'not Japanese'; it is grammatical (what comes to mind), it just does not ask for an opinion.
issues.action: Reworded to 'does not ask for an opinion'.

issues.problem: ko-mo contrast and explain claimed いつも…ない is wrong for 'never'; いつも朝ご飯を食べない is natural ('always skip breakfast'), and 全然…ない means 'not at all', not 'never'.
issues.action: Rewrote both: いつも keeps 'always' with either polarity; 'not even once' is 一度も…ない.

issues.problem: ko-demo mistake 'いつか電話してください' is a correct sentence ('call me some day'), so it was not a real error.
issues.action: Replaced with a real error: 誰でもと友達になれます → 誰とでも友達になれます (particle goes before でも).

issues.problem: x-ko-kamodemo explain said が/を always drop for all three endings, which contradicts ko-ka (誰かが, 何かが are normal).
